resources.string: Walk a pilgrim way or a city from wherever you are, carried along it by your steps: a way by the distance of your days, a city by your outings. No location, only your steps.
Distances are estimates, from your steps and your step length: measuring your step makes them truer. A day counts as Passo recorded it, so History, Insights and your way always agree.
Ways and walks drawn from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); the walks routed with BRouter. Land and water of the ways and of the continents: Natural Earth.

How long it would take shows after a week of walking with Passo.

An estimate, from your last four weeks.
A stamp for each stage reached, with its day.
It stays in Your ways, with its stamps, stopped where you are now. You can then start another way, or this one again from its beginning.
You have not walked any of it yet: it will not be kept in Your ways. You can then start another way, or this one again.
It leaves Your ways for good, with its stamps. Your days and their distance stay as they are in History.
It leaves Your ways for good, with its stamps. Its outings stay in History.
Your days from then on carry you along the way. A day in the past places you at once.

A walk through a city, in one outing or a few: each place is told, with a line about it, as your steps reach it.
Start it, then put the phone away: Passo tells each place as your steps reach it, with a short vibration. Stop when you like: the next outing goes on from there.
About %1$s steps, in one outing or a few.
The walk begins again from %1$s. Your outings so far stay in History.
The walk goes back to its start, and its stamps go with it. Your outings on it stay in History, and you can begin it again another day.

Counting is paused: turn it on in Settings to walk.

A short vibration at each place, nothing said.
At each place its name and a line about it, through headphones only.
Through headphones, or out loud from the phone when it is not on silent.
On this phone, Passo keeps it awake during the walk so each place is told on time. A little more battery: about 1 to 3% an hour.
A voice installed on this phone: Passo sends nothing.
This phone has no offline voice in this language. Install one in the system’s text-to-speech settings: until then each place is a vibration only.
